title: Request: Enable PRs from forks for contributors
body:
Hi Rich maintainers,

I have a fix ready for mixed-width text handling in , but I currently can’t open a PR to the upstream repository from my fork.

PR with the fix:
https://github.com/Siew-s-Capital/rich/pull/1

Could you please either:
1) grant me collaborator access, **or**
2) enable PRs from forks for contributors

so I can submit this change properly?

Thanks for your time and for maintaining Rich.
